observations.why: The act of switching to a new database technology appeals to novelty and self-direction — embracing a new tool over the known one.
Performance gain appeals to mastery and capability (competence) while the cost framing positions the switch as a winning, achievement-oriented move (self-enhancement).
The arrow notation frames the migration as directional progress toward the new, appealing to novelty and self-direction.
Quantified performance gain directly appeals to mastery and quality of craft in analytical capability.
Setting a concrete timeline signals capability to deliver on the migration — a competence move framing the change as achievable on schedule.
